rule.description: Deleted account has no open jobs
rule.sql: SELECT a.Account_ID, 'open jobs' FROM Accounts a WHERE a.Deleted = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Req r WHERE r.AccountID = a.Account_ID AND r.Deleted = 0 AND r.StatusText IN ('Open','Interviewing','Offer Made'))

record.About: Bridge Talent Preferred Partner Network is a consortium of 12 regional recruitment agencies collaborating on high-volume placements and candidate sharing. As an agency partner, they receive candidate referrals and supply overflow contractor availability. Reciprocal relationship supporting national coverage.
